description: C1 (placement/position lever, 600 s). Obstacle on road_1_2_0_1, the SINGLE through lane of intersection_2_2's West approach -- the highest-demand through lane of any central approach in HZ1 (206 vehicles over the run). intersection_2_2 is interior (4 intersection-neighbours). Lane 1 is the only lane serving the W->E straight movement (lane 0 = right, lane 2 = left), so one stopped car is a full movement kill with no merge-around. Position 10 m upstream of the stop line = segment 1 (stop-line placement; 100 m leaks ~64% via overtake, 10 m is airtight). Dual message: intersection_2_2 gets the approach-full bullet (West / through / segment 1, ETWT phase); intersection_1_2 gets the downstream bullet (East exit, 1 of 3 lanes, 762.8 m past its stop line on the 772.8 m link). start 500 (just before the demand ramp onto this lane; light enough for clean obstacle placement), end 1100 -> 2500 s of horizon left for queues to recover. Isolates how much of the current mildness was just location/position, before adding the duration lever.
